Map covers Matsmae to Ryūkyū Okinawa, Hachijōjima, Chōsen nantan. Relief shown pictorially. Map shows cities and towns, distance, boundaries, longitude line. Cover title. Wood block print. Pen-and-ink and watercolor. Oriented with north toward the upper right. Other title, "Kaei shinzō Dai Nihon kokugun yochi zenzu" on cover, "Nihon dōchūki" in note. Includes distance chart from Edo, "Musashi no kuni jū Edo shokoku dōhō no ki." LC copy 1 has cover; copy 2 in two sheets without cover. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Other title, "嘉永新増大日本国郡輿地全圖" on cover, "日本道中記" in note. Includes distance chart from Edo, "武藏國從江戶諸國道法之記."
